_doc: Field-level corrections of BANK items (rows of grammar_exercises, via grammar-content-cache.json), applied LAST by scripts/build-lesson-pool.mjs.

Each entry carries its reason. The same fix is written for the database in migrations/2026-10-05-a11-exercise-text-fixes.sql (applied by hand, not by the build), so the next cache dump does not undo it: once the dump carries the fix, the build reports the entry as stale and it can go.

keepBankExplanationEn: bank items whose sidecar English was reviewed (2026-10-05) and REJECTED in favour of the bank text. Every other bank item whose sidecar text differs takes the sidecar — the hand-edited layer; it used to be ignored silently, which is how the corrected L8 explanation never shipped.

keepBankExplanationEn.58dd25ce-36c5-4e52-a4cc-8ebddbdd8da0: Sidecar calls "arbeitst" unpronounceable, an overstatement; bank is accurate.
keepBankExplanationEn.da9e486f-2548-4462-9bdd-c59560ed7276: Sidecar says das "is one thing"; "Das sind meine Eltern" contradicts it.

dd1c3d60-8ae7-4c94-8990-19633dcba36f.questionDe: Meine Mutter ist hier. ___ spricht Deutsch.
dd1c3d60-8ae7-4c94-8990-19633dcba36f.questionEn: My mother is here. ___ speaks German. Refer to meine Mutter.
dd1c3d60-8ae7-4c94-8990-19633dcba36f.explanationDe: Meine Mutter ist feminin: Das Pronomen ist sie.
dd1c3d60-8ae7-4c94-8990-19633dcba36f.explanationEn: The antecedent **meine Mutter** is feminine: use **sie**.
dd1c3d60-8ae7-4c94-8990-19633dcba36f.reason: A pronoun gap names its antecedent; Es ist meine Mutter was also correct in the isolated identification sentence.

827c155d-7b87-53a3-b047-d53ab532f296.reason: The task asks for colloquial time; „sechs Uhr zwanzig“ is the official form the notice keeps apart. „zehn vor halb sieben“ is the same time in the south and east (Codex DaF review, 2026-10-07).

8908dc09-b16b-57e4-b056-e0f3060766c8.questionDe: [das / ist / sein / Schwester] → Schreiben Sie den Satz. (Beginnen Sie mit „Das“)
8908dc09-b16b-57e4-b056-e0f3060766c8.reason: Live-fix batch 1 (2026-10-25): the sentence names its opening; the 2026-10-05 seine fix is in the bank since the 2026-10-15 migration.
